item.title: Iran war: Govt prioritises LPG supply to households, hospitals, educational institutions amid energy constraints
item.description: LPG shortage: The ministry said that besides prioritising domestic LPG supply to households, they have also introduced a 25-day inter booking period to avoid hoarding or black marketing.

item.title: ‘Those responsible have to deal with it…’: India refuses IEA’s call to release strategic oil reserves
item.description: Iran war: While IEA executive director Fatih Birol is due to speak to India authorities on the issue, India is not a full member of IEA .

item.title: Adani stock: Down 18% in 2026, 5 brokers share target prices on this third-worst group performer
item.description: Analysts noted that Ambuja Cements capacity stands at 109 mtpa, which is expected to rise to 115mtpa by March end, with 10 mtpa likely to be commissioned over the next 3-4 months.

item.title: Dhurandhar 2 tickets at ₹3,100 in Mumbai, shows for Ranveer Singh's film sold out
item.description: The paid previews for Dhurandhar: The Revenge are set for March 18 across select theatres, a day ahead of its full-fledged theatrical release on March 19.

item.title: Sri Lanka hikes fuel prices by 8% to curb panic buying amid rising global oil prices
item.description: The move comes amid rising global crude oil prices, which recently crossed USD 100 per barrel for the first time in four years, driven by escalating tensions in West Asia

item.title: Farmers, exporters stare at losses due to blockade of rice exports to Gulf regions
item.description: The blockage of basmati exports has led to a price crash in local markets. Prices at which India’s small millers sell basmati rice to exporters have already fallen by 8-9%, before recovering late last week, though they are still lower by 5% compared to the last week of February

item.title: West Asia war brings India’s LPG caverns into focus amidst shortage
item.description: Oil marketing companies are carrying out detailed technical and economic feasibility studies for putting up additional underground caverns for LPG storage.

item.title: US-Israel-Iran LIVE Updates: US 'going to go further' in its strikes on Iran, says Donald Trump
item.description: US-Israel-Iran War LIVE: The war has rattled global markets, causing a rise in oil prices and an overwhelming sense of uncertainty in the global energy market.
